name: Itsu made mo Boku dake no Mama no Mama de ite! ~Aa, Ii yo Mama! Motto Motto Shaburasete!! Delivery Mama ga Strike Zone Sugite Boku no Kokan wa Mou Genkai!!!~
original_name: いつまでも僕だけのママのままでいて！ ～ああ、良いよママ！もっともっとしゃぶらせて！！デリバリーママがストライクゾーン過ぎて僕の股間はもう限界！！！～
source:
It all began with a leaflet.

"Delivery Mama 'Mother' Business service
Housework - Cleaning - Childcare
On the behalf of those who are busy, we will fill for them in as your mothers."

It was a flyer for housekeeping business service, a new agency just started in this area.
The normally apathetic protagonist held it in his hand, and called the number that was written on the leaflet.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc050/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
这一切都始于一张传单。

“送货妈妈‘妈妈’商务服务
家务 - 清洁 - 育儿
我们会代表那些忙碌的人，代替他们成为你们的母亲。”

这是一张家政业务的传单，这是一家刚刚在这一领域成立的新机构。
一向冷漠的主角将它握在手里，拨通了传单上的号码。

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc050/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
